---
title: "About"
---

## Background

I'm originally from Mexico and have called Canada home for the past 8 years. I completed my undergraduate degree at UBC with a 
Combined Major in Microbiology and Computer Science, a mix that I wasn't sure I would like at first, but eventually became a passion. 
Before starting MDS, I worked at a geochemical laboratory, where I spent my days doing high-throughput analytical work. 
That job is actually what pushed me toward this program: I kept finding the data side of the work more interesting than anything else, 
and wanted to build the skills to do more of it. 


## Why Data Science

After years of generating data in the lab, I wanted to be just as comfortable analyzing it. MDS felt like the natural next step, a chance to formalize 
the programming skills I'd picked up and turn into an actual data scientist. I'm especially interested in where data science meets biology, 
and I'm using this program to build toward data-driven roles that let me keep working at that intersection.

## Outside of Data Science

Outside of code and coursework, I love dancing (mostly latin dance). I also enjoy a good walk and reading about history. 
I'd describe myself as a curious mind at heart: I like understanding how things work, 
whether that's a dataset, a genome, or a new hobby, one piece at a time.
